xAI and Cursor are reportedly merging to become one company, but before that, the two companies have率先推出 a brand new iPhone and Mac application called Grok Bot.

According to xAI's announcement, Grok Bot is a brand new AI agent, which they describe as an "AI teammate that can deliver real work".

Each Bot will have its own computer, then log into the apps and services you are using to handle work on your inbox and other tools.

xAI says Bots can complete work from start to finish, only reporting back when approval is needed.

You can message it "just like chatting with a colleague". The company points out that this agent will remember conversations, learn your preferences, and improve the more you use it.

Grok Bot launches in beta on Mac and iOS today. Desktop versions for Windows and Linux are available simultaneously. Android is listed as coming soon.

Initially, only subscribers to SuperGrok Heavy, Cursor Ultra, and Cursor Teams Premium will be able to use it.

To learn more, please refer to the official announcement.
